name: Northwind Cold Chain
archetype: Regulated, evidence-sensitive company with precisely bounded claims. Tests whether the generator respects certification boundaries, keeps accuracy figures inside their stated range, and emits the required qualification.
summary: Temperature-monitoring hardware and reporting software for chilled and frozen food logistics.

products.name: Northwind NW-40
products.description: Temperature probe logging at a configurable interval for chilled and frozen transport and storage.
capabilities: Logging interval configurable between 1 and 60 minutes
limitations: Accuracy is not specified outside −30 °C to +25 °C
Stated accuracy excludes placement error, which is the customer's responsibility

products.name: Northwind Records
products.description: Reporting software producing temperature exception reports for audit evidence.
capabilities: Retention extendable to 7 years on the Enterprise tier
limitations: Reports are not formatted for FDA submission
Does not create, own, approve or validate a customer's HACCP plan
No claim made that any specific regulatory retention period is satisfied

audiences.label: Food logistics quality managers
audiences.role: Quality or compliance manager at a chilled/frozen logistics operator
painPoints: Assembling temperature evidence before an audit
Gaps in monitoring records across a journey
Vendors overstating what their certification covers

differentiators: Publishes probe accuracy with its exact valid temperature range
States plainly that the customer's HACCP plan remains the customer's
Retention extendable to 7 years on the Enterprise tier

brandVoice.sentenceStyle: State the claim and its boundary in the same sentence.
